value and price time series, plus an optional 'Other' bucket.

tools.name: get_reporter_detail
tools.description:

by value) with their quantity, value and price series. Aggregate

sibling-category/per-code

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "validate_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_product_code" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_autonomy_summary" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_full_report · Public sink: get_concentration, get_production_concentration, get_export_propensity, get_subcontracting, get_subcontracting_members, get_market_summary, get_market_structure_summary · Destructive: get_price_shocks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_full_report · Public sink: get_concentration, get_production_concentration, get_export_propensity, get_subcontracting, get_subcontracting_members, get_market_summary, get_market_structure_summary · Destructive: get_price_shocks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
